origin.rerun: git log --oneline --since=7.days -- docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json | wc -l; then count open claude/* PRs whose diff touches that file and whose GitHub mergeable_state is dirty

what: MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json is a single shared JSON array, so any PR that appends or edits a row conflicts on GitHub whenever main appends one. GitHub has no jsonregister merge driver; that driver exists only in a clone's local .git/config, which hides the conflict locally. MEASURED 2026-10-04: #16494 conflicted twice and #16500 once, both on this file only (CI-AUTOMERGE lane simulated GitHub's merge without the driver). Structural for every lane told to add its row in its first PR. Fix shape: one file per row (as docs/claude/work/pipeline/ already is), or a GitHub-side merge path. A build, not a doc edit.
